arguments.body:
Thank you for reporting the issue regarding the app crashing on startup after the upgrade. We take all stability issues seriously.

However, for security reasons, we cannot stage or run arbitrary commands or scripts that could introduce risk into our build environment. Please provide detailed steps to reproduce the issue, stack traces, or logs related to the crash to help us investigate further.

If you can narrow down the possible cause or any recent changes that may have led to this, let us know. We're here to help resolve this as quickly as possible!
